title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE TEAM

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll take on a pivotal, entrepreneurial role, functioning as the technical expert who thrives on complexity and commercial impact. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction and ensuring the high-quality, scalable delivery of our most challenging, high-impact projects.

This position combines deep expertise in machine learning with strategic oversight to define project roadmaps, manage technical risk, and architect reliable solutions. Your focus will be on driving innovation, mentoring cross-functional teams, and actively shaping both our technical standards and long-term customer relationships.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 

- Setting the technical direction for complex, business-critical projects and expertly balancing trade-offs between speed, innovation, and reliability.

- Designing and implementing reliable, production-grade technical solutions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architectures and specifications.

- Defining project problems, developing clear roadmaps, and overseeing end-to-end delivery across multi-disciplinary workstreams.

- Leading technical scoping and feasibility studies for high-value sales opportunities and strategic customer engagements.

- Managing relationships and communications with demanding clients, fostering trust and aligning technical solutions with shared long-term commercial goals.

- Driving the adoption of best practices, shared resources, and robust technical processes across the wider Data Science craft.

- Mentoring and developing other data scientists and team members, actively contributing to the growth and technical excellence of the organisation.

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 

- You bring depth of expertise in at least one machine learning domain and strong technical breadth across the entire data science landscape.

- You are a skilled technical leader, proficient in mentoring individuals, managing teams (including other managers), and rolling out impactful tools and workflows.

- You have proven project management expertise, capable of dividing complex, ill-defined problems into actionable, clearly defined workstreams with timelines you can defend.

- You are adept at managing ill-defined, high-risk tasks, consistently delivering innovative and practical outcomes under commercial pressure.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
Job Scope : We are seeking an experienced software engineer with experience in AI and machine learning solutions. As an engineer, you will be responsible for implementing AI-driven solutions for a wide range of applications. Your focus will include developing intelligent systems and chatbots using predictive models, LLMs, RAG and other technologies that provide substantial business value. You will also play a pivotal role in working with a talented team of engineers to deliver impactful and innovative solutions. This is a hands-on role that requires both technical expertise and a strong strategic mindset.
Key Responsibilities:

• Solution Development: Develop AI/ML-driven solutions to address complex business challenges, ensuring scalability, performance, and robustness.

• Innovation: Stay at the forefront of AI/ML trends and technologies, continually integrating the latest advancements into solutions. Do rapid prototyping( POCs) for validation.

• Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams including Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to define solution requirements and deliver high-quality outcomes.

• End-to-End Execution: Oversee the entire lifecycle of the solution from ideation and design to implementation and production.

Quality Assurance: Ensure the technical quality, scalability, and sustainability of solutions through rigorous testing, code reviews, and best practices.
Requirements

• Experience: At least 5 years of experience in software development with relevant experience in AI/ML design, and development, with a background in delivering scalable AI solutions.

• Technical Skills:

• Proficient in Python with knowledge of RDBMS, ORM and frameworks like Django, Flask or FastAPI.

• Working knowledge of ReactJS or any other JS framework/library.

• Proven experience in designing and deploying chatbots/ conversational agents using NLP techniques and frameworks such as Rasa, DialogFlow, or similar platforms.

• Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), including GPT models, and similar architectures.

• Hands-on experience with predictive modeling techniques including time series forecasting, regression, classification, and anomaly detection is a plus.

• Knowledge of advanced AI techniques like reinforcement learning, deep learning, and computer vision is a plus.

• Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).

• Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines for deployment.

• Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a drive for optimization and results.

• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to document processes and collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Professional certifications in AI or related areas are a plus.

title: Supply Chain Specialist
description:
At Rohlik, Supply Chain is about precision, speed and data.

Every day we decide what customers will find in stock - and what they won’t.

We’re now looking for a Supply Chain Specialist who will own a portfolio of categories and suppliers, ensuring strong product availability while keeping inventory healthy and waste under control.

 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- You’ll have a direct impact on product availability for thousands of customers

- You’ll work with real data, forecasts and business decisions

- You’ll see the results of your work in both numbers and customer experience

- You’ll collaborate across Category, Operations and Finance

- You’ll help automate and improve how supply chain processes work

- We are an AI-first company - you’ll work in an environment where forecasting, ordering and supply chain decisions are increasingly driven by data, automation and intelligent tools

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You’ll take ownership of day-to-day supply chain performance within your scope.

Specifically, you will:

- Own demand forecasting, replenishment and ordering for assigned categories

- Manage supplier operational performance and ensure SLA compliance (OTIF, shrink, ASN accuracy, lead times)

- Partner with Category Managers, Fulfillment Operations and Finance to balance availability, cost and inventory health

- Support automation and system improvements to reduce manual ordering

- Resolve supplier and inventory issues before they impact customers

- Track and act on key metrics such as forecast accuracy, shrink and availability

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 1-3 years of experience in supply chain, replenishment, inventory management or similar role

- Strong analytical mindset and communication skills

- Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with BI tools is a plus

- Experience in FMCG, grocery retail or e-commerce is an advantage

- Knowledge of ERP or WMS systems is a plus

- Fluent Czech/Slovak and advanced English

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

- Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary - no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

- Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

- Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility - three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

- Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

- Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live - from day one.

- Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

- Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

- A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

- If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

title: Hadoop Solutions Developer
description:
Hadoop Solutions Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Hadoop Solutions Developer
Location:  100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range:  $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required:  6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Hadoop Developer to design, build, and operate large-scale data processing pipelines and analytics platforms on Hadoop and related big-data ecosystems. In this role you will be responsible for ingesting, transforming, and analyzing massive volumes of structured and unstructured data to support enterprise analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across the Hadoop ecosystem with strong software engineering fundamentals and a clear understanding of how to deliver reliable, performant, and cost-effective data platforms in production environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and operate end-to-end big-data pipelines on Hadoop, ingesting data from a diverse mix of relational, file-based, streaming, and API-driven sources.

• Build robust ETL/ELT workflows using Apache Spark, Hive, Pig, and Sqoop, with strong attention to data quality, idempotency, error handling, and recoverability.

• Develop high-throughput streaming data pipelines using Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink, and integrate them with downstream analytical and operational systems.

• Optimize Spark and MapReduce jobs through careful tuning of partitioning, memory, serialization, and skew handling to meet demanding SLAs at minimal cost.

• Design and maintain data models and storage layouts on HDFS, Hive, HBase, and modern lakehouse formats (Parquet, ORC, Delta, Iceberg, Hudi) to balance flexibility and performance.

• Implement data governance, lineage, and quality controls in collaboration with data governance and security teams.

• Build robust monitoring, alerting, and logging strategies for big-data pipelines, including job-level SLAs and proactive failure detection.

• Partner with data scientists and analysts to deliver curated, reliable, and well-documented datasets that accelerate their work.

• Automate pipeline orchestration using Airflow, Oozie, or similar workflow engines, with clean dependency management and clear ownership boundaries.

• Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies in the big-data and cloud ecosystem (EMR, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) where they offer meaningful improvements.

• Lead performance reviews and architecture audits of existing pipelines, proposing concrete refactoring and optimization initiatives.

• Document data architectures, schemas, pipeline behaviors, and operational runbooks in a way that makes the platform supportable as the team scales.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team’s engineering standards and best practices.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of professional experience designing and operating big-data pipelines on Hadoop.

• Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (Scala, Python, or Java) in production environments.

• Solid experience with Hive, HDFS, Sqoop, HBase, and the broader Hadoop ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with streaming data platforms such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with both relational and NoSQL data stores.

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Oozie.

title: Tax Senior, Business Entities
description:
Bright!Tax is hiring a Tax Senior specialising in Business Entities, to anchor our US business entity work. You will prepare, review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for American entrepreneurs living outside the United States. You will handle most of that work end to end, and you will also review returns prepared by others so our team can learn from you. Between entity deadlines you will carry individual expat returns and the international forms that sit alongside them, so the year stays balanced. You will also mentor the preparers on our team who want to grow into entity work. This is a fully remote independent contractor role, open on location, working the US filing calendar. It will suit someone who is confident making their own judgment calls and comfortable working the way a small, fully remote firm works.
Key responsibilities

• Review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for expat-owned businesses, and prepare them end to end where that is the better fit.

• Grow into the international layer that sits on top of entity work, including Forms 5471, 8865, and 8858, GILTI and subpart F, and foreign trust reporting. Experience here is welcome, and we will teach it if you have not done it.

• Talk directly with clients by phone and video: explain positions, walk them through their entity returns, deliver completed work, and flag where their facts call for filings beyond the current scope. No selling or business development.

• Mentor and upskill Tax Team members toward independent entity preparation, in partnership with Learning and Development.

• Carry individual expat returns and international filings in the months between entity deadlines.

• Document entity standards, review checklists, and common fact patterns so the work is repeatable, reviewable, and teachable.

Must-have qualifications

• Years of experience: Roughly four to eight years in US tax with substantial entity work, enough to make a judgment call without escalating it. We care more about whether you have owned client relationships and made judgment calls yourself than about the number. We will hire at either Tax Senior or Tax Manager level, based on depth of experience and the technical authority you are ready to carry. At Tax Senior level this seat carries no direct reports. At Manager level it would likely come with direct reports as the entity bench grows. Neither level carries selling or business development responsibility.

• Credentials / licenses (e.g., CPA, EA): CPA or EA required, active and in good standing. Must hold a current PTIN and be eligible to sign as paid preparer.

• Required skills / tools: Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S; partner and shareholder basis; K-1 and K-2 / K-3 reporting; working knowledge of the controlled foreign corporation and foreign partnership regimes. Direct client contact by phone and video. Comfortable working in a cloud practice stack.

• Languages (if any): Professional fluency in English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves

• Background in a small firm or your own practice rather than a large firm environment, so you are calibrated to what a client of our size actually needs. If you run your own practice, this cannot be a side engagement alongside it. We need committed capacity across the filing calendar.

• Experience serving US owners living abroad, or time in a firm with an international or expat client base.

• Experience building technical training or running upskilling for a team.

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA) across servers, operator stations and displays

- Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

- Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

- Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

- Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

- Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

- Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

- Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

- One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

- 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

- Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

- Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

- Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

- A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

- Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

title: Senior SCADA Engineer, EPC
description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.
Job Description Summary:
The Senior SCADA Engineer, EPC will lead and execute SCADA and PPC engineering workstreams for the design, development, and delivery of the SOLV OTS SCADA solution on utility‑scale PV and BESS projects.

This role can be fully remote or hybrid, with regular in-office presence in Bend, OR. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process. Job Description:
*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned
Position Responsibilities and Duties:

• Lead the development and commissioning of SCADA monitoring and control systems for utility-scale renewable energy projects, including Solar PV and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

• Define and implement SCADA design standards and best practices aligned with company objectives.

• Own end-to-end PPC implementation on assigned projects, including programming, hardware/software integration, factory acceptance testing, and site acceptance testing to meet ISO, utility, and customer requirements.

• Generate and maintain project documentation including; SAT reports, plant control narratives, device points list, and training material while adhering to defined company standards.

• Provide expert level technical support for diverse SCADA equipment configurations.

• Serve as a primary technical escalation point for complex PPC and SCADA issues.  

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical review, knowledge sharing, and standards reinforcement. 

• Drive standardization and process improvements to reduce commissioning effort and improve system consistency across projects.

• Coordinate with customers and field technicians for on-site commissioning and installation support.

• Collaborate with cross functional teams where necessary to support the SCADA system integration

• Provide regular project status updates and risk assessments, proactively identifying and mitigating technical and schedule risks to ensure successful project delivery.

• Promote a collaborative, team-first culture by approaching challenges with a solution-oriented mindset that emphasizes enablement over barriers.  

• Operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces to define technical direction and guide solution development. 

• Promote and adhere to a culture of NERC compliance and governance with respect to programming and commissioning standards, documentation, reporting, knowledge transfer and training.

• Support operations and asset management teams during project handoff, ensuring seamless transition, operational readiness, and long-term system reliability.

title: Senior Video Producer
description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests, and we closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. More from our CEO here: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, we move fast, and the work ships to more than a million developers.

You'll join the Marketing team, which owns how Runpod looks, sounds, and shows up: the site, launches, events, social, and everything a developer sees before they create an account. Video reports directly into Brand, because we treat it as a craft function with a bar to hold, not a service desk that fills orders. Day to day you'll work with DevRel, Content, Events, and Growth.

This is Runpod's first video hire, so there's no system to inherit and nobody to hand the edit to. The demand is already real: 220 to 500 deliverables a year across social, paid, demos, and launches. The product is technical, and the audience is sharp enough to reward getting it right. You'll decide what Runpod's video system looks like: the formats we build, the templates behind them, who's on the bench, what we measure, and where the bar sits.

This is a senior individual contributor, player-coach role. You'll spend roughly 70 percent of your time hands on the timeline and 30 percent owning the queue from intake to delivery. You'll collaborate a bench of one videographer who shoots all US events, plus a motion contractor.

The focus is editorial and motion design, not live action or camera work. Both touch nearly every asset we make, and they compound: build the template once and the twentieth launch video is cheap.

- Own intake, brief, scope, schedule, delivery, and measurement for every video request at Runpod.

- Make the ship / one more round / rethink call and defend it, so craft decisions stop routing upward.

- Hold cycle-time targets: 48 hours for social cutdowns and templated assets, five business days for demos, 72 hours for event wraps, fifteen to twenty business days for bespoke launch animation.

- Keep the tracker honest: an owner and a date on every live request, and a reason when something gets killed.

- Cut every video yourself, from story and pacing to dead-air discipline and final delivery.

- Put real product on screen, legible enough that a developer takes it seriously at social sizes.

- Build the template format library covering demos, launches, customer reels, social cutdowns, and event wraps.

- Animate title sequences and data callouts unaided, with easing and type rhythm as deliberate choices.

- Build variant systems for the 30 to 80 paid ad cuts we need, so nobody is cutting 80 videos one at a time.

- Hold a current read on where AI generation earns its place and where it makes the work worse. We sell AI infrastructure, so how we make our own video is part of the argument.

- Direct the videographer and motion contractor, and require source files in every SOW so the system stays ours after the engagement ends.

- Has shipped video for a technical or developer audience, and can name the specific assets and their own role on each. A client list won't tell us much. We'll ask what a developer audience won't forgive.

- Cuts fast and finishes clean, solo: edit, sound, captions, aspect variants, delivery specs, no handoffs. Has worked to a 48-hour clock and can describe what got cut to make it.

- Comfortable with AI-capable workflow integration using Remotion or equivalent code-based programmatic video generation to build automated variant and template pipelines.

title: Go Senior Software Engineer, AI Training
description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week
Check out this Loom video for more details:
We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.
What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:
• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.
What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.
Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

ABOUT EPISCI

EpiSci, an Applied Intuition company, develops next-generation tactical autonomy solutions for national security problems. EpiSci's autonomy software is technology agnostic, operationally informed, and tactically relevant, and has piloted swarms of uncrewed aerial systems and tactical fighter aircraft. Additional applications include crewed-uncrewed teaming for air dominance, cognitive sensors, networks for advanced communications systems, and battle management command and control for informed decision-making. EpiSci delivers speed, cost-efficiency, and scalability as the preferred partner for defense agencies and industry teams seeking mission-critical autonomy solutions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This ISSO owns the day-to-day security posture of EpiSci's classified information systems, collateral and Special Access Program, across our Irvine and Poway facilities.

You will build and maintain authorization packages under the Risk Management Framework, with implementation guidance drawn from JSIG, DAAPM, ICD-503, CMMC, and the NIST 800 series. You will work directly with the ISSM to attain and maintain assessment and authorization from government authorizing officials, from initial requirements through operational deployment and continuous monitoring.

This is a hands-on seat. The work includes configuring, scanning, remediating, and standing up enclaves alongside the documentation. You can expect regular interaction with government security offices and authorizing officials, DCSA, and program security teams, and a continuous review cadence on eMASS and program packages.

Program access: This position requires Special Access Program access. Prior SAP experience is strongly preferred. Candidates with collateral-only experience and a strong track record under RMF will be considered and read on after hire.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Maintain accredited classified systems in an authorized operating state while meeting program delivery timelines

- Author, update, and defend RMF artifacts: System Security Plans (SSP), Security Assessment Reports (SAR), POA&Ms, Risk Assessment Reports, Configuration Management Plans, Incident Response Plans, Continuous Monitoring Plans, and hardware and software baselines

- Execute continuous monitoring: ACAS and Nessus vulnerability scanning, SCAP and STIG compliance checking, audit log review, and remediation tracking against CAT I, II, and III findings

- Support the design, development, and implementation of procedures and systems for secure facilities, and ensure facility compliance with requirements for classified information system processing

title: Data Executive

Overview
Data Executive
Location: UK-based role (Homebased)
Contract: Permanent, Full Time position

About The Role
This role is within our Sales Enablement team, reporting to the Sales Enablement Manager. You'll run the operational engine room behind our client reporting: capturing data from our field teams, keeping outlet and product files clean and current, producing reports, and making sure the processes behind them run the same way every time across multiple clients.
Accuracy is the job. Our reporting goes in front of leading brands, so a wrong mapping or an out-of-date store list creates real commercial risk. • Own data capture and data accuracy processes across an agreed set of clients

• Maintain call files (the store lists and visit schedules our field teams work from), handling adds, removes and changes across our systems

• Set up and maintain our data capture apps, including managing survey questions and supporting field users to capture clean data

• Maintain product files across CRM, retail data and image recognition tools

• Look after the admin that keeps our field teams equipped, including point-of-sale and field storage management

• Produce and distribute agreed reports on time and to standard

• Gather and document reporting requirements, versions and changes so every report is repeatable

• Follow agreed SLAs, templates and controls, logging issues, fixing what you can and escalating early when you can't

• Spot improvements that cut rework, from better templates and clearer inputs to automation opportunities

• Work closely with our Client Reporting & Insight Executives, who set the what and why for client outputs
What We're Looking For

• Strong Excel skills and comfortable manipulating datasets, plus good working knowledge of PowerPoint and Microsoft 365

• Highly numerate with strong attention to detail

• A methodical, right-first-time approach and the discipline to follow a standard process consistently

• A clear communicator who turns requirements into structured tasks and raises issues early, with options rather than just problems

• Calm under deadline pressure

• Familiarity with field sales data, call file management or EPOS datasets is desirable

• Experience managing recurring deadlines and multiple priorities
What's In It For You?

• Bonus - Up to 10%; paid quarterly

• 23 days holiday per annum & bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 extra days

• Family-friendly policies, including enhanced maternity, paternity, and smart working options

• Flexible working to support work/life balance

• Access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme

• Annual pay reviews, early pay access, life assurance, enhanced sick pay, health cash plan, discounted private health care & more

• Fantastic progression opportunities across the Avidity Group, including a clear path towards a Client Reporting & Insight Executive role

• We champion equality & inclusivity and are passionate about creating a workplace that promotes and values diversity
Here at Avidity , we want to support you in your career. It's the performance and engagement of our people who make this an amazing place to work. Our employees are everything to us and that's why we make sure everyone enjoys continuous support, great perks and excellent career opportunities. We work really hard to create an open, honest, high performing & diverse culture. We think that's reflective in the results we deliver, which have enabled the strong partnerships we have with our clients.

Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation.

You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships.

Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution.

- Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation.

- Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts.

- Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately.

- Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward.

- Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team.

- Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow.

WHO YOU ARE

- Sales Foundations: You have background experience in B2B or outbound sales, working comfortably against key performance targets.

- Consultative Mindset: You ask smart questions before pitching, listening intently to tailor your value proposition to each business.

- Adaptable Communicator: Exceptional telephone manner with the confidence to speak to business owners and decision-makers at all levels.

- CRM Competent: Comfortable managing a pipeline and staying organised across a busy, diverse portfolio using HubSpot (or a similar CRM).

- Resilient & Driven: Rejection doesn't derail you; it motivates you to follow up. You’re genuinely energised by hitting and exceeding targets.

- Relationship Builder: You're motivated by true customer success and prefer doing things right over closing a bad deal fast.

- Continuous Learner: You’re coachable and take ownership of your development.

LIFE IN THE TEAM

The B2B Sales team at Motorway is a tight-knit, collaborative group who work hard, celebrate wins together, and genuinely look out for one another. You’ll be encouraged to test new approaches, ask questions, and share ideas.

You'll be based in our multi-story,

title: Harness and Platform Engineer, AI Safety and Security Engineering
description:
NVIDIA is widely recognized as one of the most desirable employers, with some of the most talented people in the world working for us! We believe open-weight models are foundational to American AI leadership and cybersecurity, and that trust in AI grows through participation, transparency, and broad scientific scrutiny. Our AI Safety & Security Engineering team builds and evaluates AI-powered tooling that helps find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities. The agent harness and the platform it runs on are the substrate everything else builds on.
We are looking for a Harness/Platform Engineer to build that foundation. You will play a critical role in making the program's work possible, repeatable, and trustworthy. When a researcher runs an experiment, your platform decides whether the result can be reproduced tomorrow. Our current direction builds on NVIDIA NeMo agent tooling, and you will help shape where it goes. You will keep the whole loop visible, from environment to run to result. You will work closely with security research and evaluation engineers, learning their workflows and smoothing their paths. Good platform work here looks like fewer surprises: environments that behave, tooling that stays versioned, and runs that repeat. When something breaks, you will debug it with the people who felt it first. You will treat researcher time as precious and remove friction wherever you find it.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Harness development:Design, implement, and maintain the agent harness.

• Evaluation infrastructure:Build the systems we use to run and reproduce experiments.

• Reproducibility:Own environments, tooling, and repeatable runs.

• Collaboration:Partner with security and evaluation engineers on their workflows.

What We Need To See:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years of software engineering experience.

• Technical core:Strong Python engineering plus comfort with containerized environments and CI/CD.

• Infrastructure familiarity:Experience with agent frameworks, LLM orchestration, ML infrastructure, or evaluation harnesses.

• Reproducibility instincts:Care for versioned tooling and repeatable results.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

• NeMo experience:Hands-on work with NVIDIA NeMo or similar agent frameworks.

• Security context:Exposure to security tooling or vulnerability research.

• Developer experience:Building internal tools other engineers enjoy using.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 15, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Compute Electrical Engineer, Robotics
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and advancing toward AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world environments. Working across the full model and systems stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the physical constraints of real-world systems to improve people’s lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Electrical Engineer to develop the AI inference compute systems that power OpenAI’s humanoid robots. This role combines compute architecture, high-speed digital design, onboard power electronics, and compact HDI PCB development.

We’re looking for a self-driven engineer who takes ownership from concept through deployment. Above all, you should enjoy hands-on engineering: bringing up boards, characterizing interfaces, and tracking challenging failures to their root cause.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own compute hardware architecture and development, from component selection and schematic design through PCB layout, validation, and deployment.

- Design and integrate high-speed interfaces-including PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, MIPI, USB, and DisplayPort-balancing bandwidth, connectivity, power, and signal integrity.

- Develop onboard DC-to-DC conversion and power distribution to meet efficiency, transient-response, sequencing, and power-integrity requirements.

- Define HDI PCB stackups, dielectric materials, via structures, and routing strategies that balance electrical performance, manufacturability, reliability, and cost.

- Lead bench bring-up and validation, including test planning, high-speed interface characterization, power measurements, and debugging through verified resolution.

- Partner with thermal, mechanical, EMC, and software teams to integrate compute hardware into tightly constrained robotic systems.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have 5+ years of experience developing compute hardware or similarly complex high-speed electronics, with demonstrated ownership of complete designs.

- Bring strong hands-on measurement and debugging skills, including practical experience with oscilloscopes, probing techniques, and interface validation.

- Understand high-speed digital interfaces deeply enough to make architectural tradeoffs and diagnose issues across hardware and software boundaries.

- Have strong signal-integrity and power-integrity fundamentals, a solid foundation in power electronics, and practical experience designing complex HDI PCBs.

- Can use a Linux shell, write simple shell scripts, connect over SSH, and perform basic Ethernet and network troubleshooting.

- Take initiative, turn ambiguous requirements into concrete engineering plans, and follow through to deliver working systems.

ADDITIONAL, PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience designing around AI inference SoCs or accelerators, including their power, memory, and communication architectures.

- Familiarity with how AI inference workloads map to silicon capabilities, including compute throughput (TOPS), DRAM bandwidth and capacity, and how workload requirements and DRAM technology choices affect achievable performance and performance per watt.

- Experience bringing compute hardware into production and resolving fabrication, assembly, or test issues with manufacturing partners.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Microsoft Modern Work Solutions Principal Consultant
description:
Position Title: Senior Consultant or Principal Consultant - Microsoft Modern Work Solutions
Position Location: Remote in the Contiguous United States
Job Summary:
As a Senior Consultant or Principal Consultant (depending on experience level) within our Digital Workplace Practice, you will lead the design and delivery of Microsoft Modern Work solutions, with a focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations, and endpoint solutions with Microsoft Intune. You will guide clients through discovery, architecture, migration planning, execution, and post-migration stabilization across identity, messaging, collaboration, and endpoints. This hands-on consulting role combines technical delivery, client advisory, and team mentorship to help organizations integrate or separate workplaces while protecting data, maintaining business continuity, and minimizing disruption to users.
Essential Functions:

• Assist with statement of work development and validation as needed.

• Lead client discovery, workshops, and readiness assessments across Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and endpoint management to define Modern Work requirements, M&A objectives, migration scope, dependencies, integration or separation timelines, and business continuity needs.

• Develop migration strategies, effort estimates, workload sequencing, migration waves, cutover runbooks, and rollback or recovery plans with clear assumptions, exclusions, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate migration tools against workload coverage, limitations, client constraints, and cost.

• Develop target-state recommendations and architecture diagrams for Microsoft 365 tenant consolidation and separation, including identity alignment, hybrid dependencies, coexistence, domain transitions, access controls, and endpoint integration, in partnership with security and infrastructure teams.
